component.name: freshVision
component.summary: Capture, show and record retro computers through a Vision capture card

description.p: freshVision shows and records the picture of a Datapath Vision capture card on Linux (an independent program, not affiliated with Datapath). It is made for retro computers: RGB with sharp integer scaling, and composite or S-Video decoded in software from the card's Sync-on-Green input, for PAL and NTSC machines such as the Commodore 64, ZX Spectrum, BBC Micro, MSX and Apple II.
freshCoder, included, turns freshVision's raw composite recordings into colour video with many picture and encoding options.

ul.li: Live picture with integer scaling and low latency
Software PAL/NTSC composite and S-Video decoding with auto-tune
Machine modes that switch by themselves when the source changes
Recording with sound (NVENC, x264 or lossless FFV1)

screenshot.caption: An MSX1 on composite, decoded in software, with the control column
Detect unknown machine on a Commodore 64: settings proposed with their reasons

description.p: Experimental feature release: Detect unknown machine (proposes settings for any source, with reasons and a confidence), machine modes prepared from documentation for the Commodore 16 and Plus/4, Amiga 500/600/1200, HT 1080Z and ZX81, the Microkey Primo mode and black-and-white decoding.
